title: Faction
description: Defines a faction with comprehensive narrative integration, LLM-GM guidance, and system synergies.

name.description: The display name of the faction.

faction_type.description: The type of organization this faction represents.

era.description: The primary era this faction is most associated with, e.g., 'Galactic_Republic', 'Galactic_Empire', 'New_Republic'.

tags.description: UNIVERSAL TAGGING SYSTEM (Genesis Protocol Article II): Static tags that define this faction's characteristics, allegiances, and reputation. All tags must be defined in master_tags.yml. Examples: ['rebel_alliance', 'democratic', 'military', 'anti_empire'].

narrative.description: Rich narrative description of the faction's history, purpose, and role in the galaxy. Used by LLM-GM for storytelling.

core_ideology.description: The central beliefs, values, or principles that drive this faction.

famous_exemplars.description: Notable individuals from Star Wars lore who represent this faction.

territory.description: Description of the faction's primary territory, sphere of influence, or operational area.

influence.description: The level and nature of the faction's influence in the galaxy (e.g., 'High - official peacekeepers of the Republic').

headquarters.description: The primary location or world where the faction is based.

relationships.description: The faction's relationships with other factions and organizations.

narrative.description: Description of the relationship and its history.

mechanical_effects.description: Any mechanical benefits or penalties from this relationship.

ranks.description: The ordered progression of ranks within the faction.

rank_number.description: The numerical rank (1 being the lowest).

renown_cost.description: Renown needed to achieve this rank.

narrative.description: Description of what this rank means and its responsibilities.

benefits.description: A list of feature IDs granted at this rank.

species_synergies.description: Species that have special interactions with this faction.

class_synergies.description: Classes that have special interactions with this faction.

background_synergies.description: Backgrounds that have special interactions with this faction.

iconic_gear.description: Equipment and items strongly associated with this faction.

iconic_abilities.description: Skills, powers, or abilities strongly associated with this faction.

iconic_locations.description: Places and locations strongly associated with this faction.

narrative_hooks.description: Story hooks and narrative elements related to this faction.

typical_missions.description: Types of missions or tasks this faction typically assigns.

conflict_types.description: Types of conflicts this faction typically engages in.

recruitment_methods.description: How this faction typically recruits new members.

internal_politics.description: Description of the faction's internal structure and politics.

external_relations.description: Description of how the faction interacts with the broader galaxy.

membership_perks.description: General perks and benefits granted to all members of this faction, separate from rank-specific benefits.

skill_proficiencies.description: Skills that faction members gain proficiency in.

tool_proficiencies.description: Tools that faction members gain proficiency in.

equipment_access.description: Special equipment or items that faction members have access to.

special_abilities.description: Unique abilities granted to faction members.

image_generation.description: Data source for modular AI art generation engine.

base_prompt.description: Detailed foundational prompt for generating a 'stock image' of this faction, with bracketed placeholders for customizable parts.

contextual_modifiers.description: Modifiers defining how this faction adds flavor and context to other image prompts.

target_type.description: The type of image this modifier applies to (e.g., 'Character_Portrait', 'Location', 'Combat_Scene').

modifier_text.description: Text to append to the base prompt when this faction is part of the context.

ui.description: User interface assets and display information.

image.description: Path to the faction's representative image.

icon.description: Path to the faction's icon for UI display.
